name: Flip of the Coin → Quicksilver — v2 (delayed, exponential, mid filter)
description: v2: Delayed 4 bars → 12-bar overlap (Flip 196-208, Quicksilver 68-80). Exponential incoming curve keeps QS quiet longer. Incoming mids+bass killed on entry, ramp in over overlap. Avoids mid-frequency collision from v1.

tracks.name: Flip of the Coin (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 4A (F minor). Last peak at bars 176-184. Wind-down from bar 192, sparse at 200 (rms 0.109), ends ~208.

tracks.name: Quicksilver
tracks.notes: 3A (Bb minor). Bar 68 = mid-breakdown, bar 72 = deepest (no bass, lf=0.47), DROP at 80. first_beat_sample may need phase alignment calibration.

transitions.notes: v2: 12-bar overlap (Flip 196-208, Quicksilver 68-80). Delayed 4 bars vs v1 to skip the worst mid collision zone. Exponential incoming curve — QS stays below 0.2 for the first 6 bars, then ramps up for the drop at bar 80. Incoming bass killed, mids at 20% ramping to full with power=2 curve. Flip fades out naturally as its energy is already dying. Key: 4A→3A adjacent Camelot.
